inputTaskId.description: A prior Meshy task id to remesh (fast path). One of inputTaskId / modelUrl / sourceAssetPath is required.

modelUrl.description: A publicly fetchable model URL (.glb/.gltf/.obj/.fbx/.stl) to remesh.

sourceAssetPath.description: A stored asset (game-relative assetPath) to remesh. Requires COS so the model can be shared as a public URL.

targetPolycount.description: Target polygon budget for the remeshed model.
